integrity: The manuscript provides a proof for every allowed prime and a standard-library exact cyclotomic checker for finitely many examples. Originality remains subject to an independent bibliographic audit; no independent validation or certification is claimed.
limitations: Exact complex STFT support only; matched three-point signal and window supports; prime cyclic orders at least five. Neither phase-only coefficients nor the restriction of a single common signal and window nor composite orders is asserted. Optimal zero-support patterns are classified, not every amplitude representation.
title: Matched three-tap prime cyclic STFTs: sharp support and resonant zero patterns
